text:
riley (pm): Quick callout  drafting the model-catalog entry onboarding + pin policy. Need cross-team signoff on launch gates (bench, canary, legal). 48h?

sam (eng): Agree. Minimal bench: p50/p95 numbers, small eval slice, and a reproducible bench script. Also include expected GPU memory and quant profile.

ana (eng-ml): Eval gating: quality delta <= 5% on targeted prompts; add automated smoke tests on upload.

priya (cs): Customers ask for pin visibility in console and a clear migration playbook. For enterprise, recommend 90d pin TTL + migration credits; for self-serve, shorter TTL.

drew (legal): Two-lane contract makes sense. We'll need emergency-exit language for security/PII and DPA wording for Private deployments. Avoid hard promises about permanent pins.

riley (pm): Proposal: Starter lane (30d TTL, self-serve, no credits) and Enterprise lane (90d TTL, credits + comms + dedicated canary). Deliverables pre-GA: bench artifact, runbook, partner annex, CS comms, infra canary + dashboard.

ops-bot: "roadmap-epic" PR opened by @riley. CI checks passed :white_check_mark:.

sam (eng): We'll own runbook + bench harness. Canary requirements: 48h on reserved pool, error-rate <0.5%, KV-eviction logged.

priya (cs): We'll draft customer-facing migration notice and credit template, and schedule a small beta to validate rollback flow.

drew (legal): I'll produce the annex and emergency-exit clause for review.

riley (pm): Acceptance checklist (locking in 48h if no objections):
- Bench: attached artifact + perf targets
- Canary: 48h pass, error-rate <0.5%
- Docs: runbook + migration playbook + CS templates
- Legal: partner annex + DPA language
- Infra: canary job + dashboard with traces

Owners: @sam (runbook), @ana (eval harness), @drew (legal), @priya (customer comms).
